# docker exec from Git Bash

- Git Bash (MSYS) turns an argument that looks like a Linux path into a Windows one:
  `docker exec c /opt/mssql-tools18/bin/sqlcmd` runs `C:/Program Files/Git/opt/...` and fails with "no such file".
- Run `docker exec` / `docker run` with in-container paths from the PowerShell tool, or prefix the bash command with
  `MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1`. Volume specs (`-v D:/x:/data`) are affected the same way.
- Why: it cost a debugging round each time (2026-11-19, the AnnotationTest reset).
